primitives.note: Q's bubble and R's wave each deal a single burst of magic damage on a fixed cast-time/travel delay, on cooldown.

Ebb and Flow is a single cast that produces up to three separately-resolved bounce instances (initial hit plus up to two bounces), each with its own damage/heal value modified by the bounce-potency term.
Tidecaller's Blessing arms the next 3 basic attacks or ability-hits from the blessed unit (Nami herself in the solo dummy fight) with bonus magic damage, consumed on hit.
All four abilities cost mana (Q 60, W 70-90, E 55-75, R 100); base mana pool/regen are not in either source, so whether Nami can sustain full-rotation casting for 15s is unclear.

W's bounce alternates between enemy and ally/Nami targets and skips already-affected champions; with only one enemy dummy and no allies present, how many of the up-to-three hits actually land on the dummy is a geometry/target-availability assumption, not a stated rule.

needsBespoke.why: Nami's damage-relevant mechanics (single-instance Q/R casts, W's multi-part bounce, E's empowered-hit charges, and mana costs) are each expressible with one closed-list primitive; the open questions are about how those primitives resolve in the no-ally dummy fight, not about missing mechanics.

unsettled.question: In a 1v1 fight with no allied champions, how many of W's up-to-three hits actually land on the single enemy dummy?
options: The initial cast on the dummy deals one full-potency hit, then bounces alternate to Nami (ally-type) and then fail to find a second unaffected enemy, so the dummy is only hit once per cast
The ability still resolves three hits total (enemy, Nami, and a repeat hit on the same dummy) because 'unaffected' only restricts consecutive same-cycle targeting, not the whole cast
Nami should self-cast W first so the bounce sequence lands on the dummy as the very next (still full/near-full potency) hit instead of the initial hit
quotes: which then bounces to nearby unaffected champions up to twice, alternating between enemies and allies and Nami
each bounce modifying the effectiveness of the next by -20% {{as|(+ 15% per 100 AP)}}

unsettled.question: Do Nami's own ability casts (Q/W/R) count as the 'abilities' that consume and trigger Tidecaller's Blessing's empowered bonus damage against the dummy, or is the buff effectively only consumed by basic attacks in practice?
options: Any of Q, W, or R landing on the dummy while blessed consumes a charge and adds the full bonus magic damage, same as a basic attack
Only basic attacks realistically consume charges within the rotation because ability cooldowns rarely line up three casts inside the 6s buff window, so charges are mostly spent on autos
Sources do not specify whether an AoE ability hitting a single target consumes exactly one charge (vs. per unit hit), though with only one dummy this is moot
quotes: '''Nami''' blesses herself or an allied champion for 6 seconds, empowering their next 3 [[basic attack]]s or [[champion ability|abilities]] to each deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}

unsettled.question: Neither source states Nami's base mana pool or mana regeneration, so it is unclear whether she can sustain a full Q/W/E(+autos)/R rotation for the full 15s damage fight without going oom.
options: Assume unlimited/sufficient mana for the simulator (ignore resource-budget as a binding constraint)
Pull base mana/regen from champion stats outside these two sources and enforce it as a real cast limiter

proposal: Pre-fight: cast Tidecaller's Blessing (E) on herself to arm the next 3 attacks/abilities with bonus magic damage.
Open with Tidal Wave (R) on the dummy for the large upfront magic-damage burst (also instantly triggers her own Surging Tides passive, which is offense-irrelevant).
Cast Aqua Prison (Q) on the dummy as soon as its 0.25s cast/0.7s travel resolves, on cooldown thereafter (8-12s depending on rank).
Cast Ebb and Flow (W) on the dummy on cooldown (10s) for its direct magic-damage hit.
Auto-attack the dummy in all gaps between ability casts to keep consuming/refreshing the Tidecaller's Blessing empowered charges and to add base AA damage.
Recast E on cooldown (11s) to keep the empowered-attack buff active as much as possible.
Do not plan to recast R; its 100-120s cooldown exceeds the ~15s fight, so it is a once-per-fight opener only.
questions: Should R be cast first (to front-load burst and passive uptime) or held until E/Q are already active so the wave benefits from an empowered charge, or does that not matter since R's damage is not itself flagged as empowerable?
What is Nami's actual mana pool/regen at the fight's assumed level/items, and does it actually force skipping W or auto-attacking more to stay in mana?
Given the W bounce-target-availability question above, is it ever correct to self-cast W first instead of enemy-casting it, for maximum total damage to the dummy?
Does the 0.99s total Q travel time and 0.5s R cast+travel meaningfully change optimal cast order versus treating all abilities as instant for a 15s window?
